briefTitle: Neladalkib (NVL-655) for TKI-naive Patients With Advanced ALK-Positive NSCLC

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Histologically or cytologically confirmed locally advanced (not amenable for multimodality treatment) or metastatic Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No prior systemic anticancer treatment for NSCLC (adjuvant/neoadjuvant chemotherapy allowed if 12 months prior to randomization; prior ALK tyrosine kinase inhibitor [TKI] such as alectinib is not allowed in any setting)
